correctness.rationale: For t_i proportional to squared inverse legs, Katsuura/Feldman–Klain gives p3=(2∑acos(sqrt(t_i))-pi)/(2pi). The center has D/V limit 9/(8sqrt2) and boundary has strictly larger ratio. Lagrange multipliers plus negative g third derivative force two coordinates equal at a noncentral interior minimizer. The one-variable derivative reduces to a degree-nine Sturm polynomial with exactly one root in (1/3,1); numerical optimizer x*=0.784991151151..., C*=0.586187019691... . Independently verified third derivative sign, h(b)/h(x) exact algebraic identity, polynomial crossing equivalence, one root by SymPy Sturm, and high-precision stationarity/constant. Monte Carlo is not proof.
